nff8dcccb45.headline: Tata Teleservices hits 5% lower circuit on move to convert AGR dues into equity
nff8dcccb45.summary: Tata Teleservices shares fell to the five per cent lower circuit after the company opted to convert interest on AGR dues into equity.
nff8dcccb45.why: Tata Teleservices is an Indian telecom operator, and AGR dues are government-related liabilities that affect its capital structure.

nd560895b87.headline: South Korea Ministry of Food and Drug Safety Approves Novavax COVID-19 Vaccine
nd560895b87.summary: South Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety approved Novavax's COVID-19 vaccine, according to a Novavax press release dated January 12, 2022.
nd560895b87.why: Novavax is a US biotechnology company, and regulatory approvals in new markets can expand vaccine sales.

nc57d0f3b14.headline: EU-Poland legal row: Commission vows 'swift' response to Warsaw
nc57d0f3b14.summary: The European Commission will react swiftly to Poland's reply to a formal notice it sent to Warsaw in December, in an ongoing EU-Poland legal dispute.
nc57d0f3b14.why: EU legal actions against member states can lead to fines and affect access to EU funds, which matters for investors in Poland and the wider bloc.

n574a7dbaa5.headline: This Healthcare REIT Is Going to Use Big Data to Improve Pricing
n574a7dbaa5.summary: Healthcare REIT Welltower is working on a project to use big data to determine the right price for its properties.
n574a7dbaa5.why: Welltower is a US healthcare real estate investment trust that owns senior housing and healthcare properties, so pricing methods affect its rental income.

n897cfee0ab.headline: Cantourage brings first Ugandan medical cannabis to Germany through partnership with Israel
n897cfee0ab.summary: European medical cannabis company Cantourage has partnered with Israeli producer Together Pharma to bring the first Ugandan medical cannabis to Germany. The partnership is listed on TASE as TGTR.
n897cfee0ab.why: Medical cannabis is a regulated pharmaceutical market in Europe, and cross-border supply partnerships reflect how producers expand sourcing and distribution.

nfe792fc8af.headline: Sweden to help households as electricity prices soar
nfe792fc8af.summary: Sweden announced it has set aside about 6 billion kronor, or $661 million, for a temporary scheme to help the most affected households. The aid responds to soaring electricity prices.
nfe792fc8af.why: Electricity prices affect household consumption, inflation and the wider Nordic power market. Government support schemes change the fiscal outlook.

nb9fd142463.headline: Iberdrola enters Philippines market with 3.5GW pipeline
nb9fd142463.summary: Iberdrola has signed an agreement with Triconti ECC Renewables, the Philippines' largest independent wind developer, securing an option on five offshore wind projects with up to 3,500MW capacity.
nb9fd142463.why: Iberdrola is a large Spanish utility focused on renewable energy, and new offshore wind pipelines expand its growth outlook.

n0360feafe9.headline: MII welcomes strong 2021 Irish meat exports performance
n0360feafe9.summary: The total value of Irish meat and livestock exports increased by 4% to €3.5 billion in 2021, a strong performance given the challenges of the year, the MII said.
n0360feafe9.why: Meat and livestock exports are a significant part of Irish agri-food trade, with beef and pork sold mainly to European markets.

na3126b179e.headline: New Gold Achieves Updated Consolidated Gold Equivalent Production Guidance
na3126b179e.summary: New Gold reported fourth-quarter and annual operational results and achieved updated consolidated gold equivalent production guidance. The company is listed on the TSX and NYSE American.
na3126b179e.why: New Gold is a Canadian gold miner, and its production guidance indicates expected output that affects its revenue and cash flow.

n018d0bce4c.headline: Mainland China Markets Lead Losses in Asia; TSMC's Fourth-Quarter Profit Rises to Record
n018d0bce4c.summary: Chipmaker TSMC's quarterly net profit rose to 166.2 billion Taiwan dollars, about $6 billion, from 142.8 billion a year earlier. The result was a record.
n018d0bce4c.why: TSMC is the world's largest contract semiconductor manufacturer, supplying advanced chips to major technology companies.

n07c971ce01.headline: EXPENSIVE FUEL: +14 EUROS FOR A FULL TANK, +340 EUROS ON AVERAGE IN ONE YEAR
n07c971ce01.summary: In Italy, the average cost for a full tank of gasoline has increased by 14.1 euros compared to the same period in 2021, with diesel prices also up by 13.6 euros.
n07c971ce01.why: Fuel price increases affect consumer spending, transportation costs, and inflation, influencing economic activity and market sentiment in Italy and the EU.
